name: Marisol Vega

kit.name: Kinetic brawler (momentum theft)
kit.description: She doesn't take hits, she banks them: incoming force goes into a stored-momentum meter and comes back out with interest.

moves.name: Absorb Stance
moves.description: Soak an incoming hit into a stored-momentum meter instead of taking it clean.

moves.name: Payback Palm
moves.description: Dump stored force into one open-hand shot.

moves.name: Wallride
moves.description: Converts her own movement into a ricochet dash off any surface.

signature.name: Interest
signature.description: Stores three consecutive hits without attacking, then returns all of it at 150% in a single screen-shaking counter. High risk, highest single-hit number in the game.

nodes.name: Heavier Hands
nodes.effect: +8% damage

nodes.name: Deep Tank
nodes.effect: +15% stamina cap

nodes.name: Compound Momentum
nodes.effect: Stored-momentum meter caps at 4 hits

nodes.name: Armor-Pierce Palm
nodes.effect: Heavies and Payback Palm pierce bruiser armor

nodes.name: Bank Run
nodes.effect: +8% damage; absorbing a hit grants 2 power meter

nodes.name: Principal + Interest
nodes.effect: +10% HP and +8% damage

nodes.name: Tag In Hot
nodes.effect: Swapping in grants 1s of 20% damage buff

nodes.name: Courier Routes
nodes.effect: +10% scavenge yield

nodes.name: Corner Read

nodes.effect: Haggle: -5% at Spoke & Dagger-affiliated vendors

nodes.name: Meter Share
nodes.effect: Squad power-meter share +10% while Marisol is benched

nodes.name: Wall Coach
nodes.effect: Allies crossing her Wallride path gain a short speed buff

nodes.name: Team Captain

nodes.name: Compound

personality.summary: Competitive to the point of self-sabotage; loyal like a dog with a grudge; laughs loudest at her own worst decisions.

romance.notes: Dates like she fights — all in, no guard. Torches relationships preemptively when she catches feelings first.

recruitHook: Beat her: she challenges the player to a 1v1 in the Spoke & Dagger alley after you break up a fight she was winning. You don't have to win, but you have to land the last hit clean.
differentiation: BINDING (docs/04 §1.1): enemy telegraphs display 0.5s earlier for Marisol than for any other hero.
BINDING (docs/04 §1.1): unique interrupt-before-the-line dialogue options — uncanny at high bond, misfire embarrassingly at low bond.
